units.source_text: 有一个随从，名叫良清的，告诉公子道：

en.t: A retainer named Yoshikiyo told the prince:

units.source_text: “京城附近播磨国地方有个明石浦，风景极好。

en.t: “Near the capital, in the province of Harima, there is a place called Akashi Bay, and the scenery is splendid.

units.source_text: 那地方并无何等深幽之趣，只是眺望海面，气象奇特，

en.t: The place has no especially deep or secluded charm, but when one looks out over the sea, the atmosphere is extraordinary,

units.source_text: 与别处迥不相同，真是海阔天空啊！

en.t: utterly unlike anywhere else; truly, the sea is vast and the sky boundless!

units.source_text: 这地方的前国守现在已入佛门，他家有个女儿，非常宝爱。

en.t: The former governor of that place has now entered the Buddhist order, and he has a daughter whom he treasures dearly.

units.source_text: 那邸宅实在宏壮之极！

en.t: His residence is truly magnificent beyond measure!

units.source_text: 这个人原是大臣的后裔，出身高贵，应该可以发迹。

en.t: This man was originally descended from a minister, of noble birth, and should have been able to rise in the world.

units.source_text: 可是脾气古怪得很，对人落落不群。

en.t: But his temperament was extremely eccentric, and he kept himself aloof from others.

units.source_text: 把好好的一个近卫中将之职辞去，申请到这里来当国守。

en.t: He resigned the perfectly good post of middle captain of the guards and petitioned to come here as provincial governor.

units.source_text: 岂知播磨国的人不爱戴他，有点看不起他。

en.t: But the people of Harima did not esteem him, and rather looked down on him.

units.source_text: 他便叹道：‘教我有何面目再回京城！’

en.t: Then he lamented, ‘How could I have the face to return to the capital!’

units.source_text: 就此削发为僧了。

en.t: Thereupon he shaved his head and became a monk.

units.source_text: 既然遁入空门，应该迁居到深山才是，

en.t: Having withdrawn into the Buddhist life, he ought to have moved deep into the mountains,

units.source_text: 他却住在海岸上，真有些儿乖僻。

en.t: yet instead he lives on the seashore, which is truly rather perverse.

units.source_text: 在这播磨地方，宜于静修的山乡多得很。

en.t: In this Harima region there are many mountain villages well suited to quiet religious practice.

units.source_text: 大概他顾虑到深山中人迹稀少，景象萧条，年轻的妻女住在那里害怕；

en.t: Most likely he was concerned that, deep in the mountains where few people pass and the scenery is desolate, his young wife and daughter would be afraid to live there;

units.source_text: 又因为他有那所如意称心的邸宅，所以不肯入山吧。

en.t: and because he has that residence so perfectly to his liking, he is unwilling to go into the mountains.

units.source_text: 前些时我回乡省亲，曾经前去察看他家光景。

en.t: Some time ago, when I returned home to visit my parents, I went to look at the circumstances of his household.

units.source_text: 他在京城虽然不能得意，在这里却有广大的土地，建造着那么壮丽的宅院。

en.t: Although he could not prosper in the capital, here he has broad lands and has built such a splendid mansion.

units.source_text: 虽说郡人看他不起，但这些家产毕竟都是靠国守的威风而置备起来的。

en.t: Though the local people look down on him, all this property was, after all, acquired through the prestige of being governor.

units.source_text: 所以他的晚年可以富足安乐地度过，不须操心了。

en.t: So he can spend his later years in comfort and abundance, with no need for worry.

units.source_text: 他为后世修福，也很热心。

en.t: He is also very zealous in cultivating merit for the life to come.

units.source_text: 这个人当了法师反而交运了。”

en.t: In fact, becoming a monk has turned his fortune for the better.”
